description: This source file defines the TenantConnectionPoolMetricsTrackerFactory class, which implements the MetricsTrackerFactory interface for creating metrics trackers related to tenant connection pools in the Fineract project. It leverages Micrometer for metrics collection and appears to be part of the infrastructure core service for database metrics.

classes.name: TenantConnectionPoolMetricsTrackerFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates IMetricsTracker instances for tenant connection pools, associating metrics with a specific tenant identifier.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new TenantConnectionPoolMetricsTracker instance for the specified connection pool.
